items.q: We worked with Billy Bill about three times off and on. We'd get him grouped moved together, Bill Robinson, he loved us.

ctx.x: Oh. You know, a guy told me a story once. He told me -- let me see. He was -- that you all were working here, that you all -- sometime in the '30s, working with Bill Robinson, and Robinson was dancing out in the audience or something, and he did --
Well, he worked with -- Bill Robinson was a featured star. We worked with Billy Bill about three times off and on. We'd get him grouped moved together, Bill Robinson, he loved us.
